description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Extraordinary Gazette Notifications No. 2223/02 of 13.04.2021 is rescinded with effect from 08.09.2021
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains a regulatory order that modifies tax rates on specific commodities (onions in this case) and rescinds a previous order. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
